title: GOD ASKED HIM TO LOVE HER.
paragraphs: GOD ASKED HIM TO LOVE HER.

Not a pure woman.
Not a faithful bride.
Not a safe choice.
God told the prophet Hosea to marry a woman named Gomer.
And everyone knew what she was.

Imagine the whispers in the marketplace.
The sideways looks at the prophet of God.

“Isn’t that Hosea?”
“The man of God?”
“And that… is his wife?”
“Go, take to yourself a wife of whoredom… for the land commits great whoredom by forsaking the Lord.”
God was painting a living prophecy.

Running after other lovers.
Chasing idols.
Trading covenant love for temporary pleasure.
The heartbreak of Hosea was the heartbreak of God.

A faithful husband.
A wandering bride.
This is the scandal of the Gospel.

We chase things that cannot save us.
We give our loyalty to lesser gods.
We break the heart of the One who made us.
But God did not abandon His unfaithful people.

At the cross, Jesus absorbed the shame of our wandering hearts.
Our betrayal.
Our sin.
And through His blood, the unfaithful are welcomed home.

Not that we loved God first.
But that He loved us when we were still running.
If your story feels too messy…
If shame keeps whispering your name—
